itinerary.title: Day 1: Rainbow Mountain(13hrs of tour and trip) – in group
itinerary.body: Early in the morning, at an agreed time, we will drop by your hotel in Cusco to go to Collasuyo, south of the ancient capital of the Incas (Cusco) which was part of the Tawantinsuyo (4 ancient regions of the Incas). Our first stop will be after 2h (78km), in the community of Paucarpata ( CUSIPATA ) where we will rest and buy water or energizing drinks, snacks, cereals, etc. and also enjoy our buffet-style breakfast. Afterwards we will continue on our road transport for around 1h where we will arrive at the PHULAWASIPATA base camp and prepare to undertake the hike, a climb of approximately 2h (3.5km). During this journey we will have the opportunity to see the impressive Hatun Ritti glacier (4825m), the different varieties of South American camelids and the wonderful reflection of the landscape accompanied by the Puka Qocha and Qomer Qocha lagoons. Upon arriving at Colorful Mountain we will have enough time to take photos of this enigmatic and incredible place. Then we will return to base camp, descending for approximately 1h30 (3.5km), where we will catch our transport to Paucarpata and enjoy our delicious lunch. Finally, at around 6pm we will be in the imperial city of Cusco, where we will take you to your hotel.
